headlines.description: AC Milan's stuttering Europa League campaign continued after a 2-0 home defeat to Hungarian side Ferencvaros on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic, Milan in Europa League peril after home loss to Ferencvaros

headlines.description: Daichi Kamada's last-gasp leveller salvaged a 1-1 Europa League draw for Crystal Palace against Hoffenheim after Adam Wharton was sent off in the second half at Selhurst Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wharton sees red as Palace rescue late UEL draw

headlines.description: United States captain Tyler Adams scored his first goal since last November to help Bournemouth rally to a 3-1 win at Sparta Prague on Thursday and maintain their perfect record in this season's Europa League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tyler Adams' 1st goal in a year helps Bournemouth stay perfect in Europa
